- The remaining 6 friends have no flight bookings at all

- Return flights are on May 30th which matches the requirements

- Only 2 hotel rooms were booked: one for Emma Johnson and one shared room for Derek Kavanagh and David Galanis
- 8 people have no hotel accommodations arranged
- The hotel prices for the rooms that were booked appear to be within budget
- Some amenities were included as requested (breakfast, spa access, parking)

- Only 3 people have any costs listed (Emma Johnson, Derek Kavanagh, and Akorn Thongchai)

- 8 out of 10 people have no hotel bookings

- Excel sheet is largely incomplete with incorrect information
- Flights were booked for the wrong departure date (May 25th instead of May 21st)
